output.summary: The required Year-1 realized gross compensation must be at least $260,000. The packet provides a Base Salary of $205,000 and a guaranteed Year-1 bonus of $10,000. The equity vesting within the first 12 months is 25% of the $400,000 grant, totaling $100,000. Summing these components ($205,000 + $10,000 + $100,000) results in $315,000, which exceeds the $260,000 minimum threshold.
